overall_assessment: UiO fulltext extraction is good: all 8 fetched plans contain the full plan (intro, learning outcomes, admission, teaching, exam, facts box) and the uncaptured page text is only breadcrumbs, fetch timestamps and year pickers. The main defect is a recurring block of generic exam-information link labels appended in every plan.

findings.description: Every plan ends its exam section with the same list of link labels to UiO-wide exam guidance plus the sentence 'Andre veiledninger og ressurser finner du på fellessiden om eksamen ved UiO.' This is site-wide boilerplate, not course plan text, and sits at the end of the assessment part. Where the page has 'Adgang til ny eller utsatt eksamen', link labels such as 'Syk på eksamen / utsatt eksamen' also appear twice in a row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Selector #vrtx-content includes the shared exam-info link box; no exclude rule for it in the UiO config in R/institution_config.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exclude (or post_fn line filter) for the shared exam link list and the 'Andre veiledninger og ressurser...' sentence, and for the repeated 'Syk på eksamen / utsatt eksamen' / 'Trekk under eksamen / ta eksamen på nytt' link labels. Keep it to boilerplate per course_plan_spec.md.

findings.description: The facts box is flattened to alternating label/value lines. When a label has no value (Undervisning is empty here), the next label follows directly and a reader or parser cannot tell which label 'Vår og høst' belongs to.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Facts box serialised as plain text lines by page_fulltext(), without label: value pairing.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the facts box as 'Label: value' pairs, with an explicit empty value, in the UiO post_fn or in a block formatter.

findings.description: A spring 2025 offering of BIOS5000 has no fetched page although its URL (same as the fetched autumn offering) looks right. The institution context says 53 of 100 offerings are not fetched. Because UiO has only the current plan, this may be by design (one fetch per course code), but the packet cannot confirm that.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Probably the harvest fetches each course URL once or skips offerings sharing a URL; the error is NA rather than an HTTP error.
findings.suggested_fix: Check in harvest_strategies.R whether non-fetched UiO offerings are URL duplicates; if so, document it and have downstream steps reuse the one current plan; if not, re-fetch.
